coverage.note: structural coverage (paper Def 10): a node is covered when it is in the annotations and all its outgoing edges are; leaf exits feed junction edges that only the compositions and the root hold, so leaves alone cannot cover their exits

structures.name: S1
structures.title: 4-vs-7 separator (S1)
structures.hypothesis: 4-vs-7 separator (S1): Combines S1.1 (0/2/3/5/6/8 structure (mechanism unknown) (S1.1)) and S1.2 (0/8 structure (mechanism unknown)). They run in parallel. Together they separate 4s from 7s (76% balanced accuracy, cross-validated) much better than the best part alone (S1.2: 65%). Its strongest exit (map h119): correlates with 0s, 2s, 3s, 5s, 6s and 8s; mechanism unknown: no image rule explains it within digits (closest: a tall vertical stem, s = -0.68). It fires on 0s (87%), 2s (78%), 8s (74%), 3s (72%), 6s (65%) and 5s (59%). Evidence: Overall s = -0.68; within digits s = -0.54 on average over 7 digits; with the amount of ink held fixed, r = -0.07; add_stem edit: -0.31 SD against its control (as predicted).

structures.name: S2
structures.title: 3-vs-5 separator (S2)
structures.hypothesis: 3-vs-5 separator (S2): Combines S2.1 (No-stem detector (S2.1)) and S2.2 (No-stem detector (S2.2)). S2.1 feeds S2.2. Together they separate 3s from 5s (85% balanced accuracy, cross-validated) much better than the best part alone (S2.1: 72%). Its strongest exit (map h11): it responds when the image lacks a tall vertical stem: it is held back by a long, near-vertical stroke running most of the digit's height. So it fires on 3s (95%), 2s (92%), 5s (91%), 0s (84%), 8s (73%), 6s (61%) and 7s (56%), and on 9s that have no tall vertical stem (68% vs 13% without). Evidence: Overall s = -0.81; within digits s = -0.73 on average over 7 digits; with the amount of ink held fixed, r = -0.42; add_stem edit: -1.11 SD against its control (as predicted).

structures.name: S4
structures.title: No-left-open-upper-curve detector
structures.hypothesis: No-left-open-upper-curve detector: It responds when the image lacks an upper curve open to the left: it is held back by an upper curve that opens to the left, ink above, below and to its right (the top of a 2, 3 or 7). So it fires on 6s (100%), 0s (98%), 1s (96%), 5s (88%), 8s (79%) and 2s (53%), and on 7s that have no upper curve open to the left (44% vs 12% without). Evidence: Overall s = -0.63; within digits s = -0.46 on average over 4 digits; with the amount of ink held fixed, r = -0.51; close_upper edit: +0.88 SD against its control (as predicted); open_upper edit: -0.40 SD against its control (as predicted).

structures.name: S5

Evidence: Overall s = +0.56; within digits s = +0.41 on average over 8 digits; with the amount of ink held fixed, r = +0.43; add_top_bar edit: +1.07 SD against its control (as predicted).

structures.name: S8
structures.title: Weak open-top (4-shape) detector
structures.hypothesis: Weak open-top (4-shape) detector: It responds to a gap that opens upwards between two strokes (the top of a 4). So it fires on 0s (84%), 4s (77%), 1s (67%) and 7s (67%). annotations.name: root
annotations.title: Digit scores from the structures
annotations.hypothesis: Digit scores from the structures: Reads the structures' exits through the ten score maps and the head: each score map is a sum of kernels on the exits (and on the image directly), averaged over the map, and the head mixes the ten averages into the class scores (exact, linear). The largest direct push towards each image's own digit (score margin over the mean score, on images of that digit): '0' by Weak open-top (4-shape) detector (+11.41); '1' by No-left-open-upper-curve detector (+8.12); '2' by 3-vs-5 separator (S2) (+8.91); '3' by Top-bar detector (+14.67); '4' by No-stem detector (S7) (+12.39); '5' by No-left-open-upper-curve detector (+12.07); '6' by No-left-open-upper-curve detector (+12.33); '7' by Top-bar detector (+14.21); '8' by the image directly (+5.23); '9' by 5-vs-9 separator (S3) (+7.22).

suggester.method: attribution flow (gradient x input per edge, all class scores) + activation similarity (r >= 0.8); greedy merging that keeps the groups a DAG (5-8 structures); sub-parts by the same score inside each structure (at most 4 maps each)
